mapper.sql: USER_ID, USER_NAME as NAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD, active(IS_ACTIVE) as IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, EDITOR_USER_ID, role(USER_TYPE) as USER_TYPE
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name as name, u.password, u.email, role(u.user_type) as user_type, active(u.is_active) as is_active, g.group_id FROM users u LEFT JOIN group_members gm ON u.user_id = gm.user_id AND gm.is_active='O1' LEFT JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.group_id AND g.group_type='C1' AND g.is_active='O1' WHERE u.user_id=#{id} AND u.user_type='M2' AND u.is_active='O1'

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name as name, u.password, u.email, role(u.user_type) as user_type, active(u.is_active) as is_active, g.group_id FROM users u LEFT JOIN group_members gm ON u.user_id = gm.user_id AND gm.is_active='O1' LEFT JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.group_id AND g.group_type='C1' AND g.is_active='O1' WHERE u.user_type='M1' AND u.is_active='O1'
